summary_1line: Amid brutal battlefield chaos, Duryodhana attacks Bhima, prompting Pandava warriors to rally while Drona and others rush to defend the Kuru king.

image_candidates.scene_text: Mad war elephants locked tusk to tusk, blood streaming down their sides like red chalk on mountains while standards flutter on their backs.
Bhima leaps from his chariot and stands like a mountain with a massive mace raised, facing Duryodhana and Ashwatthama rushing toward him.
Ashwatthama’s arrows strike King Nila, his blue-cloud-like form slumping on the chariot after his horses and banner are shot down.
